evidence.detail: Passed. Row enrollment/authority-refuses-domain-store-conflict is green in one run of suite 113_veldo_0117_domain_store at c3b054f5, 45 of 45 checks true. Unit authorities (24 checks): two clones with their own Git directories and clone uuids are bound by valid signatures; the second clone's binding is varied over the eight combinations of equal and unequal domain, store uuid and canonical location. The matching binding is accepted into the committed store. Each of the three same-domain conflicts is domain_store_conflict both at admission and for the signed command, with no transaction in either store. Production path (21 checks): control_service.install lays two instances of one domain down in one install root, bound to two stores, and the suite runs each installed control_service.py serve as its unit does, handing neither a registry. The first registers its store in the install root's registry. The second is told domain_store_conflict at its start. The committed store's clone is accepted; the other store's clone is refused domain_store_conflict by the running service, naming the committed and the proposed store, with every table of both stores unchanged; a binding naming another store uuid at the committed file is refused the same way by the committed store's own instance. Each refusal is in the instance's observations. The same holds after both are stopped and started again, the conflicting one first. The clones use the production client, whose resolver returns the conflicting store without complaint. Stores and registry are read back by plain read-only sqlite3 connections. (Source branch run at c3b054f5; the line's runs are the green-after step.)

Passed. Row enrollment/one-domain-one-winner is green in the same run, 30 of 30 checks true. Two stores are proposed for an unbound domain in four schedules: each clone's store first, one after the other, and each first with the second attempt begun while the first is held inside its registration transaction. In every schedule the first is registered, the second is told domain_store_conflict with the first's identity, the registry holds one whole row, and no row is visible while the first registration is open. The winner's client gets its command accepted naming the winning identity; the loser's client is refused domain_store_conflict naming the same one. The control is two stores of two different domains started the same overlapped way: both register and both serve. (Source branch run at c3b054f5; the line's runs are the green-after step.)

checks.name: service_wiring
checks.detail: control_service.serve registers the configured store in the domain registry under the lock, before it writes the store, and gives the registry to control_client.Authority. The registry is the path the installation record names as domain_registry, else domains.sqlite3 in the install root. The installer writes no new key. domain_store_conflict has a taxonomy class (invalid_input). engine/.veldo/control_service.py is the same bytes. Proved by the production checks of the AC1 row.

checks.name: refusing_instance_teeth
checks.reason: No mutant covers serve_refusing, the branch that keeps an instance of another store from rebinding, taking on adoptions or opening a channel, API or factory loop. With the branch removed the instance still refuses every command through its authority, and the suite's installations have nothing a full start would write, so no row turns red. The suite does check that the conflicting instance's store is unchanged in every table.

checks.name: other_service_suites
checks.detail: On the line, each alone at the bring-up head: the 53 suites that name control_service or control_factory_setup. 49 passed unchanged, a fourth changed suite (86_veldo_0168_text) is VELDO-0124's, and three needed a change for this ticket, each because the started service now writes its domain registry: 85_veldo_0171_setup_api (the row that lists the files a rerun adds now sets the registry and its -shm and -wal apart and checks the registry is there), 123_veldo_0174_conversations and 96_veldo_0204_reservation_policies (their hand-written service configurations name their own domain_registry; see registry_scope). All three pass after it.

checks.name: registry_scope
checks.reason: Installations laid down in different install roots share a registry only when each record names the same domain_registry path. The installer has no option for it; the key is written by hand. Nothing checks that two roots on one host agree. Seen on the line: the default path is taken two directories above the observations file, which is the install root only in the installer's layout. A hand-written configuration with another layout gets a registry outside its own tree: the VELDO-0174 fixture services of several scratch roots shared one (and refused each other, domain_store_conflict), and the VELDO-0204 fixture's resolved to a directory it could not write. Both fixtures now name domain_registry. Whether the default should be derived another way is not decided here.

checks.name: scope_limits
checks.reason: Not judged here: one store uuid or one file registered under two different domains. The registry keys on the domain, and the spec's criteria ask about conflicts within one domain. The suite records that such a pair is not called domain_store_conflict.

rollback: Revert the commits of this branch together. The service stops registering and the Authority stops taking a registry, the refusal domain_store_conflict goes away, and suite 46 is back to ten reasons. A registry file (domains.sqlite3 in an install root, or one an operator named) stays on disk and nothing reads it. No store's schema and no installation record changed, so stores and installations written under this change open the same after the revert.
